    # Formula: p_tail = (16/3) * pi * N^2 * epsilon * sigma^3 * [2/3 * (sigma/rc)^9 - (sigma/rc)^3]
    
    # Calculate the tail factor term
    tail_factor = (2.0/3.0) * (sigma / rc)**9 - (sigma / rc)**3
    
    # Calculate pressure tail correction
